research_notes: A strict clean pass is intentionally harder to earn than simple evidence of being alive near target.
This prevents the operating policy from being based on runs that survived but failed to checkpoint cleanly.
For a persistent relay, clean continuation is more valuable than raw maximum lifetime.
That criterion aligns the experiment with the actual system objective.
The current retry has continued producing durable evidence and is ready to close at the first safe boundary once target is reached.
No scheduler action remains on the close path.
